It was first released as part of the {{TCG|Dark Explorers}} expansion. ==Card text== {{Cardtext/Header|type=Darkness}} {{Cardtext/Ability |type=Darkness |name=Dark Cloak |jname=やみのころも |jtrans=Dark Cloak |effect=Each of your Pokémon that has any {{e|Darkness}} Energy attached to it has no Retreat Cost. }} {{Cardtext/Attack |type=Darkness |cost={{e|Darkness}}{{e|Darkness}}{{e|Colorless}} |name=Night Spear |jname=ナイトスピア |jtrans=Night Spear |damage=90 |effect=Does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. ''(Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)'' }} {{Cardtext/EX |type=Darkness |ndex=491 }} {{Cardtext/Footer}} ==Release information== This card was included as both a Regular card and a {{TCG|Full Art card}} in the {{TCG|Dark Explorers}} expansion, first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Dark Rush}} expansion. The Regular print features artwork by [[Shizurow]], while the Full Art print features artwork by [[5ban Graphics]]. It was later released as one of the {{TCG|BW Black Star Promos}} with different artwork by [[Toyste Beach]] and was included in the {{TCGMerch|Black & White|Series|Legendary EX Tins}} released in September 2012. The Dark Explorers Regular print was reprinted as part of the Japanese {{TCG|Master Deck Build Box EX}}, released on September 14, 2012. The BW Promotional print was eventually released in Japan as an unnumbered {{TCG|BW-P Promotional cards|BW-P Promotional card}} and available as a prize for accumulating 10 PokéCard Points at the Battle Carnival 2013 Spring. 1 PokéCard Point was awarded for participating in eligible events at each Battle Carnival 2013 Spring venue. These events included the 3 on 3 Battle, the Limited Battle, the One Day Battle, and the Gym Leader & Team Plasma Challenge. This print features the Battle Carnival 2013 Spring logo in the bottom right corner of the illustration window. The Dark Explorers Regular print was reprinted again in the {{TCG|Legendary Treasures}} expansion, first released in the Japanese {{TCG|EX Battle Boost}} subset. The Dark Explorers Regular print was reprinted as a Non Holofoil in the Japanese {{TCG|Extra Regulation Box}} released on October 4, 2019. ===Gallery=== {{TCGGallery |type=Darkness |class=EX |image1=DarkraiEXDarkExplorers63.jpg |caption1=Regular print
